systems.system: SysRef digital solution (CDSS with electronic monitoring of vaccinations and pre- and postnatal consultations)
systems.country_label: SysRef, continued as SANU-TD (Santé Numérique au Tchad)
systems.owner: Swiss TPH with CSSI, the Ministry for Public Health and Prevention and UNHCR; funded by the Stanley Thomas Johnson Foundation, extension funded by the Swiss Agency for Development and Cooperation through PADS
systems.tiers: piloted in three health centres in southern Chad; being extended to the national health system in the south of Chad (as of April 2024)

note: Poster on user satisfaction with a clinical decision-support tool with vaccination and ante/postnatal monitoring (patient-level, programme-specific: tracker); it says nothing of HMIS reporting, paper registers or district data entry, and does not describe the tool as a general patient record, so no hmis or emr fact.
